reasons.plausibility: Tailoring REA microstructure via thermomechanical processing and aging to improve dynamic strength and ductility is generally supported by known strengthening mechanisms, though the precise behavior under high strain rates has some minor unknowns.
reasons.testability: The proposed control and comparison with a baseline under defined high strain-rate conditions outlines a clear, feasible experiment with well-defined success and falsification criteria.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a direct strategy to address known deficiencies in strain hardening and dynamic performance of refractory HEAs, thus offering significant practical value for researchers.
